text:
ana_partnerships: FYI starting a short thread to align on the SI co-sell sprint for Q3 around the marketplace + hw partner launch. Key goals: clear lead handoffs, account mapping rules, and announcement cadence. can folks chime in on blockers?

sam_sales: Love it. two quick asks — 1) what counts as an "SI-sourced" lead vs partner-introduced? 2) SLA for claiming/triage in the intake queue?

mike_se: For handoffs, my suggestion: 48h claim window for hot leads (demo requested / POC started), 72h for warm. After that, auto-escalate to regional AM. Also we should tag leads in CRM: partner_origin, si_name, marketplace_listing_id.

rachel_ps: Enablement note — we'll need a one-pager + 15min partner-ready demo script before joint announcement. Can marketing/enablement get a list of 10 target SI sales reps to prep?

jordan_ops: Intake queue ops: +1 on claim windows. We'll add an "SI claimed" status and a small webhook so SI gets notified when a lead is assigned. Question: do we require SI signed MSA before a claim?

ana_partnerships: typo — me, ana_partnerships :) Re: MSA — require a channel-level handshake only (signed LOA preferred for any co-billing scenarios). For basic intros we can accept a partner-intro form. We'll enforce for deals > $50k.

sam_sales: Makes sense. Can we capture routing rule pseudo logic somewhere? e.g., if account in HW partner region then route to hw-SI pool else route to default SI pool.

mike_se: Putting a small pseudo-table here for account mapping. rachel, this should feed enablement and AM playbooks: 

```
account_tier,preferred_route,claim_window,notify
enterprise,si-dedicated,48h,regional-am + si
midmarket,si-shared,72h,partner-rep
hw-cert-account,hw-si-first,48h,hw-partner+si
marketplace-trial,hosted-route,72h,marketplace-ops
```

rachel_ps: Perfect. I'll draft the one-pager from this. Also recommend a 'demo kit' folder in the marketplace listing with a short video (3-4 min) + test data.

jordan_ops: Ops follow-ups: 1) webhook endpoint format? 2) who owns SLA monitoring? we can wire in an alert to #partner-triage if claim > 48h.

coordinator-bot: Reminder: marketplace listing freeze for joint announcement on 2024-09-12. Any changes after 2024-09-01 require exec signoff.

ana_partnerships: timeline acked. Next actions: 
- sam_sales: finalize routing exceptions and share CRM tag list by EOD Tue.
- mike_se: validate claim webhook schema and provide sample payload.
- rachel_ps: draft enablement one-pager + demo script by Fri.
- jordan_ops: add "SI claimed" status + #partner-triage alert rule.

sam_sales: Will do. Quick Q — for co-sell crediting, are we using the existing partner attribution field or adding a new marketplace attribution token?

mike_se: prefer adding marketplace_listing_id as separate attribute to avoid overwriting partner attribution. Can map both when present.

rachel_ps: I'll include smart copy snippets for SI reps to use in outreach: short email + SFDC activity template.

jordan_ops: I'll prototype the webhook payload: 

```
{
  "lead_id": "12345",
  "account": "acme-corp",
  "partner_origin": "AtlasSI",
  "marketplace_listing_id": "mp-2024-09-redwood-v1",
  "claimed_by": "AtlasSI-rep",
  "claimed_at": "2024-08-21T15:32:00Z",
  "claim_window_hours": 48
}
```

ana_partnerships: Nice. One more operational rule: if SI does not respond within claim window, AM gets 24h to reach out, then deal moves to hosted-first routing. This prevents leads from stalling.

sam_sales: Agree. Also propose a simple escalation tag in SFDC: partner_escalation_Q3.

mike_se: Heads up on technical side — hw partner accounts sometimes require an on-prem demo kit. we should mark those as "hw-cert-account" in mapping. ops, can we flag these for shipping?

jordan_ops: Yes — we'll add a fulfillment flag and notify hw-fulfillment.

rachel_ps: I'll prepare the partner-facing cheat sheet and run a 30-min enablement call next Wed. Ana, can you invite the SI POC list?

ana_partnerships: will do. final ask — anyone see legal or procurement blockers for joint announcement? I think procurement wants LOA for co-billing but not for basic joint marketing.

sam_sales: Procurement ok with LOA for co-billing > $50k as you said. Legal wants to review joint press release text. we should loop them in early.

ana_partnerships: great. I'll set a short sync on Mon to review the draft ops playbook and the announcement timeline. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

mike_se: quick note for records — capturing this thread into /partners/playbooks/si-co-sell-q3.md after we ship docs.

jordan_ops: added the #partner-triage alert rule to our staging monitoring. will push to prod after validation.

rachel_ps: ✅ I'll post the enablement draft in this thread when ready.

ana_partnerships: excellent — closing the loop. if anyone needs to add exceptions DM me. :party_parrot:
